_about: Saturday's good news, as rows (Krish, 2026-11-19, of Sat 28's ideas board: "We also need to significantly improve the good news suggestions. These are still all just one idea, mostly, and they're not good news carousels. Some of them are memes that are sneaking through, and the only actual uplifting carousel is about AI in hospital again, which is all we post about. We should find good news that's not medical stuff."). Then (Krish, 2026-11-19, answering the questions on content-engine#923): "Sat should just be good news carousels - 5 great things AI is doing for people (ideally things that make people smarter or better or happier or more successful)." and "Can mix if no1 is implemented properly." So a carousel may mix topics; its lead theme, when three or more of its stories share one, is what repeats and medical limits read. Read by scripts/post-pack/idea_checks.py goodnews_findings (the Sunday run's gate, code goodnews) and apps/control-plane/api/board/_goodNews.ts (the ideas board holds a Saturday option that is not a good-news carousel, with the reason). A new kind of good news, a limit or a keyword is a row here, never code.
sector_note: Ruling (Krish, 2026-11-26: "Make sure all the good news suggestions and meme suggestions are also aligned to the new positioning, as well as the carousels."). The good news is people in the creative, arts, music, entertainment, media and sports industries doing, earning or making more with AI (config/beat.json offdays.good_news). So each focus sector of config/beat.json leads the topics below as a topic and a story kind of its own (music, film_tv, games, creators, arts_design, performance, sports, media, creative_tools, rights), read by idea_checks.good_news_config: a carousel of musicians is led by music, and the lead and repeat rules spread the Saturdays across the sectors. From config/story-score.json from, idea_checks.offday_beat_findings (code off_beat) refuses a good-news story outside the focus sectors. The general rows stay for the boards before it.
stories_note: Four since 26 Nov 2026: the 3-second carousel format's good-news roundup carries 4 items (config/carousel-format.json good_news; the Library's CAROUSEL-FORMAT.md worked example B: five break the 50-word ceiling). Krish, 2026-11-26: "Tell the Content-engine story intelligence for makeyourmindup v5 session that it is to enforce carousel formatting." A fifth story found is a spare, never drawn.

bar.words: four great things AI is doing for people in the creative, arts, music, entertainment, media and sports industries, ideally making them smarter, better, happier or more successful

why_medical_wins: Health and hospital stories dominate search results for 'AI good news', so a search that is not steered returns them first every week. Search each domain on its own, and choose the topic where five strong stories meet outside medicine.
